confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: the RBA rate, general Split prices, and Split cocktail and wine prices. I did not run all five permitted price searches. Sources were travel guides and price databases that disagree, and some were dated 2023–2026. I used rough mid-range figures (beer about €4.50, cappuccino about €3, cheap meal about €13, two-person mid-range dinner about €60, cocktail about €10, wine glass about €5). I converted them at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15, which I did not check. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for July peak season. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: I based the estimates on Split's own price ranges. Split is a peak-season Adriatic tourist city, priced a little below Dubrovnik and above Zagreb.
